user.title: Connect to your Times Frame
user.description: Enter the frame's IP address and Divoom DeviceID. To find it, send a POST request to https://app.divoom-gz.com/Device/ReturnSameLANDevice while connected to the same LAN, then match DevicePrivateIP to the frame's IP and copy DeviceId. Setup checks that the local frame reports the same ID.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device at that IP and port.
error.device_id_mismatch: The device did not return a DeviceID, or it does not match the configured ID. Check DeviceId and DevicePrivateIP in Divoom's same-LAN device list.
error.invalid_response: The device returned an invalid response and its identity could not be verified.
error.device_error: The device rejected the identity check.

abort.already_configured: This Divoom DeviceID is already configured.
